date_note: Abnormal access dated 11 Nov by MTN and 10 Nov by Dailysecu; the Federation's first notice was 14 Nov (the date used here); it confirmed the leak in an 18 Nov notice.
title: Korea Federation of SMEs confirms leak of over 360,000 Yellow Umbrella customer records
org: Korea Federation of Small and Medium Business (Kbiz)
impact: The Federation says over 360,000 records of customer personal and contract information leaked, including account numbers and payment details.
summary: The Korea Federation of SMEs confirmed on 18 November that over 360,000 customer personal and contract records leaked from its Yellow Umbrella site, Dailysecu and Yonhap report; Yonhap says that is about 18.9% of 1.92 million members, up from about 205,000 first reported to the privacy commission on 14 November. Leaked items include names, addresses, business details, payment amounts and bank account numbers. Dailysecu dates the access to 10 November; MTN to 11 November.

evidence.quote: 노란우산 재적 가입자 192만명의 약 18.9%에 해당하는 규모로, 가입자 5명 중 1명꼴이다.
지난 14일 개인정보보호위원회에 제출한 침해신고서에서 약 20만5천명의 개인정보가 유출된 정황이 있다고 신고했다.

plain: A Korean small-business mutual-aid scheme says over 360,000 customer records leaked, including names, addresses and bank account numbers.
exec: A large business body confirmed a leak of over 360,000 records with payment data, which fuels targeted fraud and phishing.
action: Dailysecu reports the Federation urges customers not to click links in unclear text messages or emails or enter personal or financial details; MTN says customers can check on the Yellow Umbrella site whether their data was involved.

validation.note: MTN (14 Nov) and Dailysecu (19 Nov) both read; both relay the Federation's own notices. They differ on the access date (11 Nov MTN, 10 Nov Dailysecu). Follow-up 23 Nov: Yonhap (18 Nov 17:15, reprinted on koreancenter.or.kr) gives the 18.9% share, the earlier 14 Nov report to the Personal Information Protection Commission, says the Federation corrected the date from 11 to 10 November, and says the Commission is checking the facts of the leak and reporting. An earlier Yonhap version (11:50) gave 362,000 people and 11 November 08:30; the later version is used. No attacker named.
